findings: Token cache race on worker concurrency: _TOKEN_CACHE is mutated without a threading.Lock; two workers can simultaneously refresh an expiring token. Add threading.Lock around the check-and-refresh block.

Loading skeleton flash on background polls: fetchDevices calls setLoading(true) on every 60-second poll; while in an error state this flashes the skeleton over the error message on each interval. Suppress setLoading for background polls.
Silent truncation at 200 devices: ?pageSize=200 with no pagination loop means large accounts get an incomplete list and the Total Devices card undercounts. Add a pagination loop or document the cap.
